prompt: Grignard chain extension: 1-butanol → 1-bromobutane (HBr) → butylmagnesium bromide; then add formaldehyde (HCHO) and workup. Draw the final alcohol (one carbon added).
explanation: RMgBr + HCHO (formaldehyde) is the classic one-carbon chain extension strategy. The Grignard adds across the CHO giving a 1° alcohol one carbon longer than the original halide.
